name: io.github.synpulse8-opensource/pulse8-ai-cortex-knowledge-vault
description: Agent-native knowledge OS on Markdown: typed graph, hybrid search, and compiler over MCP.

environmentVariables.name: CORTEX_VAULT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the Markdown vault directory the server reads and writes.

environmentVariables.name: CORTEX_LLM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional OpenRouter (or compatible) API key. Only needed for LLM cross-referencing during compile; file conversion and search work without it.
